preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The group size K is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: S consists of alphanumeric characters and dashes
preconditions.description: The string S contains only alphanumeric characters and dashes.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is the same as the input string S.

postconditions.expression: output[i] in '0-9A-Z-' for i in range(len(output))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either a digit, an uppercase letter, or a dash.
The number of dashes in the output string is one less than the number of groups formed by splitting the input string S by dashes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) == K for group in output.split('-')[:-1])
postconditions.description: Each group except the last one has exactly K characters.
The last group may have fewer than K characters but must contain at least one character.
The output string is obtained by converting all lowercase letters to uppercase, removing all dashes, and then inserting dashes at the appropriate positions.
